articles.summary: The ATSC 3.0 standards have been reference as part of 3GPP standards for 5G. ATSC 3.0 based service deployment is starting this year. There are many powerful incumbent players not only in the OTA broadcast, but also the OTT streaming and the broadband wireless services markets. Will the consumers benefit from new, innovative hybrid services that combine the best of the broadband wireless and the broadcast Internet?
articles.title: Will ATSC 3.0 Finally Deliver the Promise of a Broadcast Internet?
